features.title: Engine fork, Guimarães config, shell, green build
features.user_visible_behavior: The app runs for the Guimarães city config and draws its terrain and city fabric.
features.notes: Forked from braga-3d. cities/guimaraes.json holds the centre, core and ring bboxes, 18 candidates.

features.title: Core geodata: terrain, buildings, roads, nature
features.user_visible_behavior: The map shows real Guimarães terrain, OSM buildings, the street network and green areas.

features.title: Landmark content for 18 places (RU/EN/PT) + photos + merge
features.user_visible_behavior: Each landmark card shows real text in Russian, English and Portuguese with credited photos.
evidence: commit eb731f6 (texts for all 18 landmarks, credited Commons photos, merged locales)
check-data OK: 18 landmarks, 90 gallery photos, 40 videos, 3 routes
features.notes: history_ru normalized to 900..1800 chars / 3..5 paragraphs and facts_ru to 3..5 items <=110 chars across the source fragments; re-merged.

features.title: Footprints and real-world dimensions with sources
features.user_visible_behavior: Landmark footprints match OSM and dimensions carry cited sources.
evidence: check-dimensions OK: 18 landmarks, all numbers finite, positive and sourced

features.title: Ring tiles and Microsoft buildings
features.user_visible_behavior: The city continues past the historic core with Microsoft building shapes.
verification: Visual: ring tiles and MS buildings render
evidence: commit 83590e0 (362 ring tiles, MS buildings core+ring)

features.title: Living city: POIs, streetscape, life, Penha cable car
features.user_visible_behavior: Street-level detail (calçada, trees, terraces, people) and the animated Penha cable car are shown.
verification: Visual: Pois, streetscape and the cable car render and animate
evidence: commit 917408f (OSM street level: pois, streetscape, 623 trees, terraces, people; Penha cable car)

features.title: Three routes
features.user_visible_behavior: Three authored routes are selectable and drawn on the map.
verification: Visual: each route draws and its card opens
evidence: commit f3ca363 (3 routes: core-day, penha-day, two-days)
features.notes: Route leg pts normalized to 5 decimals.

features.title: Story mode: 10 chapters
features.user_visible_behavior: Story mode walks through ten chapters of Guimarães' history.
verification: Visual: story mode advances through all chapters
evidence: commit f3ca363 (10 chapters RU/EN/PT + views, Story tool enabled)

features.title: Faithful 1:1 landmark models on real footprints
features.user_visible_behavior: All 18 landmarks are recognisable 1:1 procedural models, not generic massing blocks.
evidence: waves 2 & 5 raised fidelity: total 243,765 tris (<600k); check:fit within tolerance; commits f0c00d9, a4994e1

features.title: Guimarães identity: granite-and-Penha palette, castle mark, dawn opening, cinema
features.user_visible_behavior: The city has its own palette, mark, opening and cinema order, distinct from Braga.
verification: Visual: palette, castle mark, dawn opening and cinema behave

features.title: Engine sync mechanism with braga-3d
features.user_visible_behavior: Engine fixes can be ported from braga-3d in one documented step.
verification: scripts/sync-engine.sh reports changes; scripts/engine-base.txt records the base
features.notes: Report-only by default; --apply copies, --record advances the base.

features.title: Deploy to Vercel and a custom domain
features.user_visible_behavior: The production site is live on the custom domain with working API routes.
verification: Check /p/<id>/, /og/ and the API routes on the live domain
evidence: Vercel project guimaraes-3d, alias https://guimaraes-3d.vercel.app HTTP 200
